reader.requirement: At 1985 the ALTERNATE RECORD KEY clause's data-name-1 may be written with qualifiers (IN/OF data-names and/or the file-name, per §1985:IV.4.3.8.1 Format 1), must resolve uniquely, and admits no subscript (2002's subscripted operand) nor the later SOURCE or SUPPRESS WHEN phrases.

edition-consulted.switches: Edition.SubscriptedClauseOperands (Year == 2002) admits a subscripted key operand; 1985 and 2023 refuse it (COBOL2024)

reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: SUPPRESS WHEN and SOURCE are refused at 1985; the qualified-name resolution itself is the same code
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_bf21_08 covers OF/IN data-name qualification; not covered: file-name as qualifier, the ambiguous unqualified refusal, a qualifier that names nothing or an item outside the file

probes.printed: ALT 002 dat2/PRI AAA dat1/G 009 gdat FS 0000/WS WWWVVV
probes.expected: ALTERNATE RECORD KEY IS K2 IN GRP OF REC-F and K2 OF IX-G (file-name qualifier) both resolve; READ KEY by the alternate key returns the right record

probes.printed: error COBOL1639 ALTERNATE RECORD KEY 'K2' does not uniquely identify a data item (3 declarations)
error COBOL0863 'K2' references nothing described in this program (§1985:IX.2.5.3 SR2)
error COBOL0863 'K2' references an item outside this file's record descriptions
probes.expected: refused: K2 OF WS resolves outside the file

probes.printed: error COBOL2024 ALTERNATE RECORD KEY 'K2 IN GRP OF REC-F (1)' is written with a subscript
error COBOL0900 SUPPRESS WHEN phrase requires COBOL-2023 (targeting COBOL-85)

reader.notes: Key operands resolve through the one qualified-reference resolver (QualifiedCandidates then UniqueOrReportAmbiguous) inside ResolveFiles' InRecords local, so the file-name qualifier works. COBOL1639 and COBOL2024 cite §2023 clauses at --std 85 (diagnostic wording only).

refuter.evidence: q1.cob --std 85 (runs/q1-001): ALTERNATE RECORD KEY IS K2 OF REC-F2 WITH DUPLICATES, the key described only in the file's SECOND record description (GR4) and qualified by that record-name while a same-named WORKING-STORAGE K2 exists, skipping the intermediate group GRP (partial qualification): READ KEY IS K2 OF REC-F2 -> ALT 002 BBBdat2 02 (first-written duplicate, status 02); ALTERNATE RECORD KEY IS K3 OF REC-G (two levels skipped) and READ KEY IS K3 OF SUB -> G 009 gdat 00. Together with the reader's k1/k3/k4/k5/k6/k8 this covers qualification by record-name, intermediate group and file-name, and the refusals. cite.py: 'OK  §1985:IX.2.5.3 SR1  (║2.5.3 Syntax Rules║)  the text is in SR1'.
